confirmed_findings.evidence: An independent generic View with identical public title text could not rejoin guidance because page identity required TextView.
confirmed_findings.change: Collect native heading metadata through AndroidX compatibility; accept explicit headings and finite toolbar identities; retain ancestor, window, privacy and control checks.

confirmed_findings.evidence: Unknown native search IDs blocked the whole page; Android JSONObject null text also failed the old empty-string check.
confirmed_findings.change: Use exact native search hints as local facts, handle JSON null explicitly, discard empty search nodes before HTTP. Nonempty queries, passwords, unknown editors and private descriptions remain blocked.

confirmed_findings.evidence: Government24 labels in virtual child nodes were not candidates when the real clickable parent owned the action.
confirmed_findings.change: Bind an unambiguous public label to its native clickable ancestor, deduplicate one owner, reject mixed rows and distinct duplicate owners; do not read editable values.

confirmed_findings.evidence: The generic button check ran before RadioButton and classified native selection controls as ordinary buttons.
confirmed_findings.change: Preserve the radio selection role before generic button matching.

confirmed_findings.evidence: NewApi lint found 7 findings: an unguarded API-33 InputStream read, an unguarded API-28 accessibility setter, and API-30 screenshot callback references inside an existing version guard.
confirmed_findings.change: Use a buffered read and AndroidX accessibility setter; isolate screenshot callbacks in a version-specific class; add the NewApi check to CI.

confirmed_findings.evidence: The environment classified one launcher as supported although the privacy and capability contracts rejected it.
confirmed_findings.change: Align environment support with the existing finite export/capability scope; unsupported launchers are not newly authorized.

limits: No device was connected for installation or live flow testing of this revision.
The unidentified phone incident is not proven to have the same cause as any individual controlled reproduction.
Robolectric SDK cases do not establish compatibility for every manufacturer, OS build, display configuration or Government24 version.
Unknown labels and headings inside unverified interactive or scrolling containers remain conservative; this change does not enable arbitrary screen export or unrestricted navigation.
The general app still declares versionCode 1 and versionName 1.0; the artifact hashes and source revision identify these APKs.
